user.title: Luna Climate
user.description: Sets up the Luna Climate controller. Zones are added afterwards under Configure.

abort.already_configured: Luna Climate is already set up.

data_description.thermostats: Climate entities that regulate themselves. They receive the zone's target temperature.
data_description.temp_sensors: What measures the zone. Leave empty to fall back to the thermostats' own readings. Required when the zone has linked devices.
data_description.linked_devices: Switches with no control loop of their own, such as a towel warmer. Luna switches them against the measured temperature.
data_description.humidity_sensors: Optional. Leave empty to use the humidity sensors on the same devices as the zone's temperature sensors and thermostats.
data_description.away_enabled: Drop to the away temperature when nobody is home. Turn off for rooms that should keep their schedule regardless.

presence.title: Home & away
presence.description: One list for the whole house. When every tracker is off (or not_home), all zones that follow away drop to their away temperature.

error.no_devices: A zone needs at least one thermostat or one linked device.
error.sensor_required: A zone with linked devices needs a temperature sensor to regulate against.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Raises a zone's target for a set time. When it expires the zone returns to whatever applies at that moment, not to the block that was running when the boost started.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the boost lasts, in minutes.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Absolute target during the boost. Leave empty to add the zone's boost offset to the current target.

cool_for.name: Cool for
cool_for.description: Reserved for the air conditioning half. Not implemented yet.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to cool, in minutes.

start_precomfort.name: Start precomfort
start_precomfort.description: Suppresses away mode so every zone resumes its current schedule block. Cleared when somebody arrives, or after the precomfort timeout.

clear_precomfort.name: Clear precomfort
clear_precomfort.description: Ends the precomfort grace period immediately.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: List of blocks: weekdays (0 = Monday), start (HH:MM) and value (off, max, or 18-25).

set_target.name: Set target
set_target.description: Holds a zone at a fixed value and pauses its schedule. Ends any running boost.

value.name: Value
value.description: off, max, or a temperature. 27 or above counts as max.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Hands a zone back to its schedule.
